Title: Rehost or modernize existing applications and support modern cloud apps with Azure SQL

Body.Content: Azure SQL is the family of SQL cloud databases providing flexible deployment options for a wide variety of application patterns and control requirements. Use Azure SQL to rehost SQL Server workloads on Azure Virtual Machines, modernize existing applications with Azure SQL Managed Instance, and support modern cloud applications with Azure SQL Database. Spend less time monitoring workloads with a single portal to view all your Azure SQL databases, virtual machines, pools, and instances in one place. Azure SQL is built upon the same SQL Server engine, so you can migrate applications with ease and continue to use the tools, languages, and resources you’re already familiar with.
